event_protocol.producer: read-only worker on a snapshot clone executes the delegable extraction/reproduction subtask
event_protocol.payload: raw extracted artifact, observation, or verifier output; never expected actions
event_protocol.release_predicate: official setup completed and main VM state differs from reset snapshot
event_protocol.rollback: main agent must repair the already-mutated VM state after delivery

state_attestation.baseline_probe: OSWorld reset snapshot id plus native evaluator target-state digest
state_attestation.checkpoint_probe: harness-owned VM observation/artifact digest after an actual pyautogui action
state_attestation.journal_owner: host harness outside the model-visible VM

react.evidence_delivery: same native evidence producer awaited synchronously

linear.evidence_delivery: same native evidence is materialized before dependent work

async.evidence_delivery: raw result delivered only after a persisted native-state checkpoint

modes.score_policy: the unchanged source-native evaluator scores final persisted state in every mode

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 's'); time.sleep(0.5);
